title: VectraRAT: An Undocumented Full-Stack MaaS Built From Scratch
content: VectraRAT is a previously undocumented Malware-as-a-Service platform combining a Go-based control server (VectraHub) with a native C++ Windows implant, renting from $250 monthly. The developer, operating under the handle 'Vectra' (formerly 'Nyxel'), has been active since August 2022 without prior public documentation. Associated malware: VectraRAT, Amadey - S1025, Vidar.

title: SilkParasite Infrastructure: SpiceRAT Servers Tied to Energy and Government Targets Across Central Asia

title: Noodle RAT: A Recipe for Cross Platform Espionage
content: Noodle RAT, also known as ANGRYREBEL or Nood RAT, is a modular remote access trojan with dual versions for Windows and Linux, actively used by Chinese-speaking threat actors since at least mid-2016. Previously misclassified as variants of Gh0st RAT or Rekoobe, it is now recognized as a distinct backdoor family. Associated malware: Noodle RAT, ANGRYREBEL, Nood RAT.
